degree_level.quote: a graduate of an approved engineering curriculum of at least 4 years

school_approval_basis.quote: "Approved engineering curriculum" means an engineering curriculum or program of 4 academic years or more that meets the standards established by the rules of the Department.

required.quote: submits acceptable evidence to the Board of an additional 4 years or more of experience in engineering work of a grade and character that indicate that the individual may be competent to practice professional engineering

exams.notes: Required for engineer intern enrollment; also required as part of PE licensure path
exams.quote: who has passed an examination in the fundamentals of engineering as defined by rule

exams.quote: an examination in the principles and practice of engineering as defined by rule

required.quote: The Department may adopt rules of continuing education for persons licensed under this Act.

available.quote: The Department may, upon application in writing on forms or electronically accompanied by the required fee, issue a license as a professional engineer to an applicant already licensed under the laws of another state, the District of Columbia, a territory of the United States, or a foreign country if the requirements for licensure in that other jurisdiction were, on the date of original licensure, substantially equivalent to the requirements then in force in this State.

requirements.value: Requirements for licensure in the other jurisdiction must have been substantially equivalent to Illinois requirements at the time of original licensure.
requirements.quote: if the requirements for licensure in that other jurisdiction were, on the date of original licensure, substantially equivalent to the requirements then in force in this State

exists.quote: The Secretary shall appoint a Professional Engineering Board. The Board shall consist of 10 members who shall serve in an advisory capacity to the Secretary.

name.quote: "Board" means the State Board of Professional Engineers of the Department.

authority.value: advisory capacity to the Secretary; makes written recommendations on qualifications for licensure, curriculum content, standards of professional conduct, and formal disciplinary actions
authority.quote: Obtain written recommendations from the Board regarding qualifications of individuals for licensure and enrollment, definitions of curriculum content and approval of engineering curricula, standards of professional conduct and formal disciplinary actions, and the adoption of the rules affecting these matters.

national_association.value: National Council of Examiners for Engineering and Surveying (NCEES)
national_association.quote: Maintain membership in the National Council of Examiners for Engineering and Surveying and participate in activities of the Council

regulatory_model.quote: Any person who practices, offers to practice, attempts to practice, or holds himself or herself out to practice as a professional engineer or engineer intern without being licensed or exempt under this Act shall, in addition to any other penalty provided by law, pay a civil penalty to the Department

credential_type.quote: "License" means an official document issued by the Department to an individual, a corporation, a partnership, a professional service corporation, a limited liability company, or a sole proprietorship, signifying authority to practice.

is_mandatory.quote: Any person who practices, offers to practice, attempts to practice, or holds himself or herself out to practice as a professional engineer or engineer intern without being licensed or exempt under this Act shall, in addition to any other penalty provided by law, pay a civil penalty to the Department

title_protection.quote: who, by verbal claim, sign, advertisement, letterhead, card, or any other way, is represented to be a professional engineer, or through the use of the initials "P.E." or the title "engineer" or any of its derivations or some other title implies licensure as a professional engineer

scope_protection.quote: Any person who practices, offers to practice, attempts to practice, or holds himself or herself out to practice as a professional engineer or engineer intern without being licensed or exempt under this Act shall, in addition to any other penalty provided by law, pay a civil penalty to the Department

disciplinary_grounds.description: Material misstatement in furnishing information to the Department
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Material misstatement in furnishing information to the Department.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Negligence, incompetence, or misconduct in the practice of professional engineering
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Negligence, incompetence, or misconduct in the practice of professional engineering.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to comply with any provisions of this Act or any of its rules
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to comply with any provisions of this Act or any of its rules.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud or misrepresentation in applying for or procuring a license or renewal
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fraud or any misrepresentation in applying for or procuring a license under this Act or in connection with applying for renewal or restoration of a license under this Act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Purposefully making false statements or signing false certificates or affidavits to induce payment
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Purposefully making false statements or signing false statements, certificates, or affidavits to induce payment.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a felony or misdemeanor involving dishonesty directly related to professional engineering
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of or entry of a plea of guilty or nolo contendere, finding of guilt, jury verdict, or entry of judgment or sentencing, including, but not limited to, convictions, preceding sentences of supervision, conditional discharge or first offender probation under the laws of any jurisdiction of the United States that is (i) a felony or (ii) a misdemeanor, an essential element of which is dishonesty, that is directly related to the practice of the profession of professional engineering.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Aiding or assisting another person in violating any provision of this Act or its rules
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Aiding or assisting another person in violating any provision of this Act or its rules.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to provide information in response to a written request made by the Department within 60 days
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to provide information in response to a written request made by the Department within 60 days after receipt of such written request.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in dishonorable, unethical, or unprofessional conduct likely to deceive, defraud, or harm the public
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in dishonorable, unethical, or unprofessional conduct of a character likely to deceive, defraud, or harm the public.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Habitual or excessive use or abuse of controlled substances, alcohol, or other substances resulting in inability to practice safely
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Habitual or excessive use or abuse of drugs defined in law as controlled substances, of alcohol, narcotics, stimulants, or any other substances that results in the inability to practice with reasonable judgment, skill, or safety.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to pay a fine imposed by the Department
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A finding by the Department that an applicant or licensee has failed to pay a fine imposed by the Department.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of terms of probation after license placed on probationary status
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A finding by the Department that the licensee, after having his or her license placed on probationary status, has violated the terms of probation or failed to comply with such terms.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Inability to practice with reasonable judgment, skill, or safety due to physical or mental illness or disability
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Inability to practice the profession with reasonable judgment, skill, or safety as a result of physical illness, including, but not limited to, deterioration through the aging process, loss of motor skill, mental illness, or disability.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Discipline by another state, territory, foreign country, or government agency for substantially equivalent grounds
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Discipline by another state, territory, foreign country, the District of Columbia, the United States government, or any other government agency if at least one of the grounds for discipline is the same or substantially equivalent to those set forth in this Act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making a willfully false oath or affirmation in any matter or proceeding where an oath is required
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The making of any willfully false oath or affirmation in any matter or proceeding where an oath or affirmation is required by this Act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Using or attempting to use an expired, inactive, suspended, or revoked license or impersonating another licensee
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Using or attempting to use an expired, inactive, suspended, or revoked license or the certificate or seal of another or impersonating another licensee.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Giving or receiving fees, commissions, rebates, or other compensation for professional services not actually rendered
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Directly or indirectly giving to or receiving from any person or entity any fee, commission, rebate, or other form of compensation for any professional service not actually or personally rendered.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Signing or affixing seal to technical submissions not prepared by or under the engineer's supervision
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Signing or affixing the professional engineer's seal or permitting the seal to be affixed to any technical submissions not prepared by the professional engineer or under the professional engineer's supervision and control.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making a false statement that a construction plan complies with the Environmental Barriers Act when it does not
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making a statement pursuant to the Environmental Barriers Act that a plan for construction or alteration of a public facility or for construction of a multi-story housing unit is in compliance with the Environmental Barriers Act when such plan is not in compliance.

establishment_regulation_required.quote: Any business, including a Professional Service Corporation, that includes within its stated purposes or practices, or holds itself out as available to practice, professional engineering shall be registered with the Department pursuant to the provisions set forth in this Section.

definition_quote.value: the consultation on, conception, investigation, evaluation, planning, and design of, and selection of materials to be used in, administration of construction contracts for, or site observation of, an engineering system or facility, where such consultation, conception, investigation, evaluation, planning, design, selection, administration, or observation requires extensive knowledge of engineering laws, formulae, materials, practice, and construction methods.
definition_quote.quote: "Professional engineering practice" means the consultation on, conception, investigation, evaluation, planning, and design of, and selection of materials to be used in, administration of construction contracts for, or site observation of, an engineering system or facility, where such consultation, conception, investigation, evaluation, planning, design, selection, administration, or observation requires extensive knowledge of engineering laws, formulae, materials, practice, and construction methods.

methods_authorized.quote: the consultation on, conception, investigation, evaluation, planning, and design of, and selection of materials to be used in, administration of construction contracts for, or site observation of, an engineering system or facility

covers_land_surveying.quote: 225 ILCS 330/ - Illinois Professional Land Surveyor Act of 1989.
covers_land_surveying.citation: UMBRELLA / Chapter 225 - PROFESSIONS, OCCUPATIONS, AND BUSINESS OPERATI

covers_geology.citation: UMBRELLA / Chapter 225 - PROFESSIONS, OCCUPATIONS, AND BUSINESS OPERATI

engineer_intern_certificate_available.quote: "Engineer intern" means a person who is a candidate for licensure as a professional engineer and who has been enrolled as an engineer intern.

postgraduate_degree_experience_credit_ye.quote: Upon completion of a Master's degree in engineering, the applicant may receive one year of experience credit. Upon completion of a Ph.D. in engineering, an applicant may receive an additional year experience credit for a maximum of 2 years.

responsible_charge_defined.quote: "Direct supervision/responsible charge" means work prepared under the control of a licensed professional engineer or that work as to which that professional engineer has detailed professional knowledge.

seal_required_on_documents.quote: All technical submissions prepared by or under the personal supervision of a professional engineer shall bear that professional engineer's seal, signature, and license expiration date.

seal_document_types.quote: Technical submissions are the designs, drawings, and specifications that establish the scope of the professional engineering project, the standard of quality for materials, workmanship, equipment, and constructions systems, and the studies and other technical reports and calculations prepared in the course of the practice of professional engineering.

firm_practice_allowed.quote: Any business, including a Professional Service Corporation, that includes within its stated purposes or practices, or holds itself out as available to practice, professional engineering shall be registered with the Department pursuant to the provisions set forth in this Section.

exemptions_from_licensure.quote: Nothing in this Act shall prevent: (1) Employees, including project representatives, of professional engineers lawfully practicing as sole owners, partnerships or corporations under this Act, from acting under the direct supervision of their employers.

code_of_ethics_in_statute.quote: In the performance of any of the foregoing functions, a licensee shall adhere to the standards of professional conduct enumerated in 68 Ill. Adm. Code 1380.300.

board_member_responsible_charge_years_re.quote: 9 members shall (i) currently hold a valid professional engineering license in Illinois and shall have held the license under this Act for the previous 10-year period

retired_status_license_available.quote: Any person who has been duly licensed as a professional engineer by the Department and who chooses to deactivate or not renew his or her license may use the title "Professional Engineer, Retired".
